newsitem.title: USA: General Employment Q2 net rises with demand.
newsitem.headline: General Employment Q2 net rises with demand.

text.p: General Employment Enterprises Inc said Tuesday strong demand for information technology employees helped earnings climb 68 percent in the second quarter ended March 31.
The company, which operates 34 employment offices in 13 states, posted net income of $675,000 or $0.25 a share versus $401,000 or $0.15 last year.
Revenues, aided by the opening of six new offices in 1996, climbed to $7.3 million from $5.8 million a year ago, the company said.
General Employment said the outlook for the second half is "excellent," adding that it plans to open four more offices by the end of the fiscal year.
The company's shares were up 7/8 Tuesday at 10-5/8.
